one_line: A Licchavi aristocrat-officer presiding in the Vaishali santhagara assembly, c. 6th–5th century BCE.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, athletic medium build, upright bearing of a disciplined warrior-statesman.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp jawline, medium wheat-brown complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, keen slightly large anime-style eyes with dark irises, a narrow vertical tilaka of light sandalwood on the forehead, default expression composed and observant with a hint of stern focus.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a high, tight topknot at the crown wrapped with a narrow dark-red cloth band, sides neatly smoothed back, no loose strands; no helmet in assembly, but a simple narrow bronze circlet with a small central boss rests just above the forehead.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate north Indian aristocratic attire: a knee-length, off-white cotton or linen tunic (like an early long uttariya-style kurta) with three-quarter sleeves and a modest round neckline, worn over a finely pleated ankle-length dhoti in muted deep saffron wrapped tightly and knotted at the front, border edged with a thin dark-green stripe; over his left shoulder and across the torso is a soft, broad shawl/uttariya of light grey with a subtle woven chevron pattern, its end falling behind; he wears a plain brown leather belt with a small bronze buckle at the waist, simple brown leather sandals with thong straps, a single narrow bronze armlet on the right upper arm, a pair of small round bronze ear studs, and a string of wooden prayer-like beads (sal-tree look) around the neck, all fabrics matte and practical but finely made, no excessive ornament.
appearance.signature: A smooth, polished wooden salaka voting tally rod about a foot long, slightly darker at the grip, held or tucked at his belt, accompanied by a small, flat rectangular wooden ballot tray under his arm that marks his role as ballot-collector and quorum officer in the santhagara.

ref_desc: Licchavi Saṅghāma is a wheat-brown, sharp-jawed man in his early 30s with a neat short beard, black hair in a high topknot with a dark-red band and bronze circlet, wearing an off-white tunic, deep-saffron dhoti, light-grey uttariya shawl, simple bronze jewellery, and brown sandals, always carrying a polished wooden salaka tally rod and flat ballot tray in a palette of off-white, deep saffron, light grey, dark red and bronze brown.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Licchavi Saṅghāma, a 6th–5th century BCE Vaishali aristocrat-officer: an athletic man in his early 30s with medium wheat-brown skin, sharp jaw, neat short beard and moustache, and keen large dark eyes with a slim sandalwood tilaka; his black hair is pulled into a high tight topknot wrapped with a narrow dark-red cloth band, topped by a simple narrow bronze circlet with a small central boss above the forehead. Dress him in an off-white knee-length tunic with three-quarter sleeves over a finely pleated ankle-length deep-saffron dhoti with a thin dark-green border, and drape a broad light-grey uttariya shawl with subtle chevron weave from his left shoulder diagonally across the torso. Add a plain brown leather belt with a small bronze buckle, small round bronze ear studs, a single narrow bronze armlet on the right upper arm, a string of simple wooden beads at his neck, and brown leather thong sandals; keep the garments modest, fully covering torso and legs. His signature props are a polished wooden salaka voting tally rod about a foot long, darker at the grip, held in one hand or at his belt, and a small flat rectangular wooden ballot tray tucked under his other arm, indicating his role as ballot-collector and quorum officer in the santhagara. Use a restrained palette of off-white, deep saffron, light grey, dark red, bronze brown and hints of dark green, and show him from multiple angles to emphasize the consistent face, high topknot with red band and circlet, specific garments, and the ever-present salaka rod and ballot tray.
